run_unicode_case_fold: run the script to generate a C++ case folding function from a Unicode database file
parse_unicode_mappings: parse a Unicode case folding database and extract Common and Simple mapping entries
generate_cpp_fold_function: generate a C++ foldCharSimple function implementing simple case folding from Unicode data
dump_case_folding_blocks: dump optimized C++ code blocks for Unicode case folding with stride and shift patterns
validate_unicode_database: validate a Unicode case folding database for duplicate or unsorted character entries
